home.subtitle: Manage the platform's websites, communities and tenants — continue in the dashboard.

stripe.title: Stripe
stripe.sectionFailed: Stripe is not responding right now

status.title: Status
status.description: What this deployment is currently using to talk to Stripe.
status.liveHint: Every checkout really charges the customer's card. To try things out, enter an sk_test_ key instead.
status.taxWrongTitle: The tax default does not match the advertised prices
status.taxWrongHint: The landing page and help centre quote 29 € and 149 € as final prices including 19 % VAT. If the default is not „tax included“, Stripe adds the tax on top. Set it to „inclusive“ in the Stripe dashboard under Settings · Tax — before the first live price, because a price's tax behaviour can never be changed afterwards.

keys.title: Keys
keys.description: Stored encrypted and taking precedence over the server environment. Only the last four characters are ever shown.
keys.secretHint: Starts with sk_live_ or sk_test_. Verified against Stripe once before saving; if that fails, the previous key stays in place.
keys.webhookHint: Starts with whsec_. Not needed if you let the webhook below be created — the secret is then stored automatically.
keys.errorInvalid: Stripe rejected this key — nothing was saved
keys.errorMalformed: That does not look like a secret key (sk_live_ or sk_test_)
keys.errorWebhookMalformed: That does not look like a signing secret (whsec_)
keys.errorNoStorage: Storage is not set up — NUXT_BILLING_SETTINGS_KEY is missing
keys.errorStorageKeyInvalid: NUXT_BILLING_SETTINGS_KEY is set but malformed — 64 hex characters expected (openssl rand -hex 32). Nothing was saved.
keys.noStorageTitle: Keys cannot be stored here yet
keys.noStorageHint: The server needs NUXT_BILLING_SETTINGS_KEY for this — 64 hex characters, generated with openssl rand -hex 32. Until it is set, NUXT_STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and NUXT_STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET from the server environment remain in charge.

prices.title: Prices
prices.description: The four plan prices. The amounts live in the code — this only compares which of them exist at Stripe.
prices.landingTitle: Changing amounts does not update everything
prices.landingHint: A new amount applies to new subscriptions immediately; existing subscriptions keep their old price. The prices shown on the website live separately in the code and have to be updated by hand.
prices.confirmIntro: This deployment talks to real money. For these prices the amount at Stripe differs from the catalogue — the reconciliation creates a new price each, moves the lookup_key onto it and archives the old one:
prices.confirmNote: Existing subscriptions keep their price. New subscriptions are signed at the new amount from now on.

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.description: Stripe's way back. Without it this instance never learns about payments, cancellations or failed charges.
webhook.secretStored: The signing secret was stored automatically.
webhook.errorNoAppUrl: Without NUXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL the address is unknown
webhook.errorGeneric: The webhook could not be set up
webhook.secretUnconfirmedHint: The endpoint exists, but this deployment did not create it — the stored secret comes from the server environment, was entered by hand, or belongs to an earlier endpoint. Stripe only ever hands the secret out at creation time, so it cannot be compared. If it does not match, the webhook rejects every delivery. Only „Recreate endpoint“ gives certainty.
webhook.recreateConfirmTitle: Recreate the endpoint and replace the secret?
webhook.recreateConfirmBody: The existing endpoint is deleted at Stripe and a new one with all nine events is created. The signing secret produced along the way is stored immediately and replaces the previous one. Deliveries Stripe happens to be retrying at that moment are lost.
webhook.errorSecretNotStored: Endpoint created, secret NOT stored — delete it at Stripe and create it again
webhook.errorNoStorage: Without NUXT_BILLING_SETTINGS_KEY the secret cannot be stored — nothing was created
